messages:
Eloise Carter: heads-up — doing a quick pass on the Roles & Invites flows. found a few edge UX/a11y items around bulk-invite, role inheritance visuals, and audit filters. TLDR: want an undo for bulk actions, clearer inherited-role indicator, and saved audit presets. 
Ben Howard: undo for bulk-invite sounds vital. suggestion: after a bulk send, show a toast with 'Undo (30s)' that reverts invites -> draft and removes pending invites from matrix. server should mark a reversible action id.
Rina Shah: accessibility: any undo toast must be announced by SR as "Undo bulk invite available" and focusable. keyboard users should be able to navigate to toast and press Enter. avoid auto-dismissing without user control.
Omar El-Amin: role inheritance: we currently show a tiny chevron for inherited roles. low contrast and ambiguous. propose an inline pill: 'inherited from <parent org>' with subtle border and an info button that opens a short explainer. pills should be readable at 14px.
Eloise Carter: agreed. also add a hover/focus state that shows which permission bits are inherited vs explicit. small matrix overlay that toggles on demand.
Ben Howard: for bulk-invite modal: include an option 'Send as pending (require invite accept)' vs 'Create user + send notification' — helps SSO orgs where account creation is constrained. default to pending for orgs with Enforce SSO. we need copy to explain difference.
Rina Shah: inline copy must be concise: 'Pending: invite sent, account created after acceptance' vs 'Create: account created immediately, may be blocked by SSO'. use aria-describedby linking to more info.
Omar El-Amin: audit presets: users keep recreating the same filters (role=admin + event=invite + last 30d). can we add 'Save filter' in Audit Log and expose quick chips at top of timeline? also exportable preset URLs so Support can paste them in tickets.
Eloise Carter: good. for exportable URLs include a short param set and a copy button. security note: don't leak user PII in URL fragments — use encoded filter ids, not raw emails, unless user explicitly chooses.
Ben Howard: small keyboard flow: when saving a filter, focus should land on the name input in the modal. hitting Enter saves and closes. ESC cancels and returns to the timeline focus.
Rina Shah: contrast on role badges in the matrix still failing on some combos. run color-blind sims + contrast check. Temp fix: add a 1px outline and bold label. permanent: pick palette with >=4.5:1 against surface.
Omar El-Amin: audit navigation: deep-link to a row in the timeline is helpful (to highlight an event). implement anchor-like behavior, but ensure it's stable across pagination. prefer anchor + breadcrumb 'context around event' showing 3 events above/below.
Eloise Carter: also think about mobile/responsive: matrix collapses to cards, but role descriptions get truncated with '...'. add a 'read more' button that expands inline instead of changing page layout.
Ben Howard: copy unify: We have 'Require SSO' and 'Enforce SSO' used interchangeably. decide on 'Enforce SSO' in toggles and admin UIs. docs can use 'Require SSO'. I'll update product glossary.
Rina Shah: accessibility checklist for these changes: toast SR announcement, focus management for modals, aria-describedby on pills, keyboard reachable undo, contrast checks, no reliance on color alone for inheritance. I'll stub tests.
Omar El-Amin: engineering notes: reversible bulk actions need a flag and a cleanup job after window expires. saved audit presets map to DB id and shareable token. donut hole: revoking invites created via undo must cascade to downstream identity providers — add notes for infra.
Eloise Carter: action items: Omar -> feasibility + infra notes; Ben -> copy updates + toast pattern; Rina -> SR text + tests; I'll update Figma with inherited-role pill, undo toast, and audit preset flow. aim to review Monday.
UXAuditBot: accessibility test ticket opened (#A11Y-492) and assigned to Rina.
